PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),   # PTAT branch current at 27C
    "k":      (9.3, 8.0, 11.0),       # R2/R1 ratio (sets TC cancellation)
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # core PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # core PMOS mirror L (high ro, matching)
    "Va":     (0.15, 0.08, 0.25),     # level-shift drop raising OTA input CM
    "gmid_in":(15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # OTA input pair gm/Id
    "Iota":   (5e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # OTA tail current
    "Cc":     (5e-12, 2e-12, 12e-12), # dominant-pole cap at pg
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    I0 = p["I0"]; k = p["k"]
    UT0 = 0.02585
    R1 = UT0 * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = k * R1
    Ra = p["Va"] / I0

    # predicted common-mode at OTA inputs (27C)
    veb = 0.76 + UT0 * math.log(I0 / 10e-6)
    vcm = veb + p["Va"]
    vdd = 1.8

    # core PMOS mirror (3 identical branches)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=vdd - vcm)

    # OTA: NMOS input pair with resistor tail, PMOS mirror load
    Ib = p["Iota"] / 2.0
    vsb = 0.3
    for _ in range(3):
        mi = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], 1.0, Ib, vds=0.4, vsb=vsb)
        vsb = max(0.1, vcm - mi.vgs)
    vt = vsb
    Rt = vt / p["Iota"]
    ml = lut.size("p", 12.0, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # bipolar core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.R("Ra1", "a", "e1", Ra)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    n.R("R1", "r1", "e2", R1)
    n.R("Ra2", "b", "r1", Ra)
    # PMOS mirror branches
    n.dev("M3", "a", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "b", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # output branch: Vref = Veb3 + I*R2
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # OTA (diode side senses b => negative feedback)
    n.dev("Mi1", "d1", "b", "t", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("Mi2", "pg", "a", "t", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("Ml1", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("Ml2", "pg", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.R("Rt", "t", "vss", Rt)
    n.C("Cc", "pg", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # start-up: pull pg low while vref is low
    n.M("Ms2", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Ms3", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    vref = veb + k * UT0 * math.log(N)
    # PTAT slope k*ln(N)*UT/T vs Veb slope ~ -1.65 mV/K
    slope = k * math.log(N) * UT0 / 300.0 - 1.65e-3
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 12.0   # residual curvature ~12 ppm/C
    power = vdd * (3 * I0 + p["Iota"] + 0.3e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
